'''Master Hunter''' was a term that referred to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who had completed one hundred or more successful [[Bounty/Legends|hunts]] assigned by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. They had reached the level of independence where the guilds offered them hunts, but no longer ordered them to take one. They could choose whatever bounty they wanted, when they wanted. They were also given authority to employ [[Journeyman Hunter|Journeyman]] and [[Apprentice Hunter]]s to assist with hunts as needed. They typically had been successful enough to own their own ship as well.
